title: Event pipeline

milestones.title: [P5.1] Event pipeline: partitioned ingestion and replayable consumers
milestones.task: Use SHA-256 of account to choose a fixed partition count. Assign increasing offsets transactionally. Repeat the same event ID and payload to obtain the original offset; reject a changed payload. Persist the partition count as immutable configuration.
milestones.failureInjection: Changing partition count in place can reorder an account and invalidate existing checkpoints. Require a migration instead of silently rehashing a durable log.
milestones.evidence: Show stable account affinity, increasing offsets, and duplicate ingest returning the original position.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P5_1 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

milestones.title: [P5.2] Event pipeline: projections, duplicate handling, and late-event tests
milestones.task: Maintain integer account totals. An event with an earlier event_time still changes the total once when it arrives. Store a deduplication marker and advance the partition checkpoint in the same transaction as the total.
milestones.failureInjection: A checkpoint committed ahead of a projection loses work; projection committed without dedupe can double-apply retries. Keep the transaction boundary explicit.
milestones.evidence: Apply +10 at time 200 and −3 at time 100, consume twice, and reconcile to exactly 7.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P5_2 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

milestones.title: [P5.3] Event pipeline: checkpoint recovery, batch replay, and reconciliation
milestones.task: Inject a failure after a projection write but before checkpoint persistence. Verify rollback, reopen the database, and consume again. Build a named shadow projection with its own checkpoints, leaving live data available.
milestones.failureInjection: Rebuilding live state by deleting it first creates an avoidable outage and makes validation difficult. Compare the completed shadow projection before any future cutover.
milestones.evidence: Show zero partial projection after the injected failure, correct recovery, and a successful independent replay reconciliation.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P5_3 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

milestones.title: [P5.4] Event pipeline: schema/backfill failure tests and evidence report
milestones.task: Accept v1 amount and v2 amount_minor_units as explicit schemas with integer money units. Reject unknown versions and same-ID payload conflicts. Recompute expected account sums from source events and compare derived totals.
milestones.failureInjection: A guessed default for an unknown schema can silently corrupt totals. Quarantine unsupported inputs upstream and make failure visible instead of treating them as zero.
milestones.evidence: Mix two supported versions, reject a future version, and report expected versus actual totals. Document the rollback condition for a shadow projection cutover.
milestones.testCommand: py -3 -m unittest discover -s projects/tests -p test_projects.py -k P5_4 -v
milestones.stopCondition: Stop when the focused deterministic test passes and the stated evidence is recorded. Extensions are separate practice.

baselineArtifact: Partitioned ingest, projections, replay, migration tests
authorship: original prepared teaching implementation; curriculum names and milestone IDs source-derived
invariant: Each accepted event has a stable ID and immutable payload. A projection update, deduplication marker, and checkpoint advance commit atomically within the teaching database.
requirements: Partition events deterministically by account and order ingestion offsets within each partition.
Apply additive minor-unit deltas correctly even when event-time order differs from arrival order.
Recover checkpoints, rebuild a separate projection, upcast supported schema versions, and reconcile against the immutable source.
architecture: validated event → immutable partitioned SQL log → bounded consumer batch → atomic applied-ID + account total + checkpoint; replay writes a named shadow projection.
limitations: All log/projection state is in one SQLite authority. The transaction is not a promise of exactly-once external effects or a distributed stream processor. Late-event semantics here are additive totals, not event-time windows.
extensions: Add event-time windows, watermarks, and an explicit policy for late corrections.
Introduce a separate sink to show why cross-database checkpoints need idempotent effects.
referenceReveal: Explicit reveal in the academy; reference source also remains inspectable on disk. Educational spoiler control, not secure examination.
